Name: JP's Farms - Ultra Bigger Farm - Big Farm
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][center][b][i][color=#ff0000][u]Ultra Bigger Mega Supreme Extreme Creme Super Duper Whopper Really Belly Steady Standard Farm[/u][/color][/i][/b][/center][/size]

[b][color=#00ff00][size=5][center]Because there is never enough space when you plan to be a capitalist tycoon and you already have the whole town full of your casks, among other...[/center][/size][/color][/b]
[b][i][color=#00ffff][size=6][u]Map Features:[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]A 200x200 map (maybe a little more) or the equivalent of almost 4 normal farms together. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]All this is yours, you'll just have to clean it up a bit.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]A optional system of teleports that will take you to every corner of the farm (the pattern of the Warps zone matches the location you will be taken to in the farm).[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Optional riceponds on the left side of the map if rice is your thing.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]A big optional pond if you want to pamper your ducks and let them swim in it. (Optionally you can also swim in it.)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Let your greedy self get your hands on this map, I'll look the other way....[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]
[b][i][size=6][color=#ffff00][u]
Installation:[/u][/color][/size]
[/i][/b]
[b][size=4]Download the mod, unzip it in the Mods folder of the game. Configure it with the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. Check the mod requirements.[/size]

Adds a new map instead of replacing the original.
Download and extract in Mods folder. Check new mod requirements. If you like the mod don't forget to click on the Endorse button at the top of the page, it helps me a lot :D
